title: Enhancing Event Candidate Acquisition for Event Linking
abstract: arXiv:2609.13670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Event linking associates event mentions in text with entries in a knowledge base (KB), or identifies them as out-of-KB events. Although existing methods use different architectures, candidate event acquisition can still be weakened by short ambiguous mentions, noisy arguments, and evidence that is unevenly useful for retrieval. We present MACE, a Multi-Agent Candidate Event acquisition method that refines event structure before linking. MACE uses evidence-specialized LLM agents to acquire time, location, participant, and event-type evidence, exposes intermediate queries to candidate-event lookup tools, and lets a coordinator revise the evidence set before final candidate construction. Experiments on two event linking benchmarks show that adding MACE to different event linking models consistently improves accuracy. translated_title: 增强事件链接中的候选事件获取
translated_abstract: 事件链接任务旨在将文本中的事件提及与知识库（KB）中的条目相关联，或者将其识别为库外事件。尽管现有方法采用了不同的架构，但候选事件获取仍然可能因简短模糊的提及、嘈杂的论元以及对检索效果参差不齐的证据而被削弱。我们提出了MACE，一种多智能体候选事件获取方法，它在链接之前细化事件结构。MACE使用专门针对证据获取的大语言模型（LLM）智能体来收集时间、地点、参与者和事件类型证据，将中间查询暴露给候选事件查找工具，并让协调器在最终候选构建之前修订证据集。在两个事件链接基准上的实验表明，将MACE添加到不同的事件链接模型中均能持续提升准确性。这些结果表明，MACE通过更好的候选事件获取来改进事件链接，而无需修改事件链接模型本身。
tldr: 本文提出多智能体候选事件获取方法MACE，通过专门的LLM智能体收集并协调修订时间、地点、参与者和事件类型等证据，在链接前细化事件结构，从而在不修改事件链接模型本身的情况下持续提升事件链接的准确性。
en_tdlr: MACE is a multi-agent candidate event acquisition method that uses evidence-specialized LLM agents to collect and refine time, location, participant, and event-type evidence before linking, consistently improving event linking accuracy across different models without modifying the linking models themselves.
